lines.japanese: 「いや、おれ一人でも充分だけど」
lines.english: “I’d be perfectly fine on my own, though.”

lines.japanese: 男らしいことを言ったつもりが不評だった。
lines.english: I had meant it to sound manly. The reviews were poor.

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ごめん冗談、渡来さんがいないと終わらないよ」
lines.english: “Ahaha—sorry, I’m kidding. I’d never finish without you, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「言い方てきとーう。もういい帰る。さようなら羽田君、そして永遠に」
lines.english: “That sounded completely phoned in. Fine, I’m going home. Farewell, Haneda. Forever.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　ああ、待って帰らないで、おれが悪かったよ」
lines.english: “What? Wait—don’t go. I’m sorry, I was wrong.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは小悪魔的な笑みを添えて、浮かしかけた体をすっと戻した。
lines.english: With a wicked little smile, Watarai smoothly settled back into the seat she had only begun to rise from.
